title: Certify the alpha74 deletion-quantifier gap
body:
## Summary

```text
fixed P112 U7,V4 covers; eight orthogonal root normals
  each normal has its own one-root cut -> span 8
  ONE common two-root cut -> span at most 2 on these eight only
  universal common-two span <=5 -> UNSETTLED
```

Add one exact quantifier counterexample and partial handoff from the alpha74 common-cut investigation. Direction-dependent one-root deletions already attain the full ambient span, so the predecessor's larger deletion relaxation cannot prove the requested common-cut bound. The original no-extra-cut alpha74 theorem is unchanged.

Credit DreamingOfClouds/PR3154, Nick Petalas/PR3289 and the retained canonical E8/P112 geometry lineage. Exact predecessor proof/code bytes, source pins, scope correction and Open next questions are included. No pending Git objects are needed for direct replay.

## Evidence

- Before: the common-cut handoff remains open, and a direction-dependent tester would be a tempting relaxation. After: an explicit orthogonal basis, realizable binary cover closures and eight singleton cuts show that relaxation has span eight. All 512 functional restrictions per normal certify the exact common-cut rule for this family.
- A separate matrix-reduction checker covers all 6,216 common root pairs, with histogram 5,356 / 832 / 28 qualifying zero/one/two normals. It shares the authenticated geometry input; no independent model audit is claimed.
- Registered CPython 3.12 replay, optimized behavioral/source controls and Ruff pass. All three actual scripts pass from the committed read-only Git-free export under optimized CPython 3.13, with stable hashes and private control copies. Designated internal peer review is retained in REVIEW.json.

```sh
python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-alpha74-cut-quantifiers
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in package. The maximum two concerns only the exhibited eight normals. The original universal ONE-common-P span-five predicate remains UNSETTLED; no caller exclusion, full C5, decoder floor, physical supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed. Historical censuses, human/proof-kernel review, Lean, Docker and selected cold replay are unrun. One inherited trailing space is preserved in the verbatim pinned source note; newly authored paths pass the diff check.
